decisions.reason: A multi-model handle family close to the core range supports system breadth and long architect specification cycles, so withdrawal within a year is unlikely.
A single design is more exposed to range rationalisation and was not observed on the website in 2020-2021, but the low cost of keeping it argues for retaining it.
This single handle design faces some risk of being pruned from the range, yet it remains a cheap complement to the established offer.
A handle family with several models covering different budget levels fits the strategic direction and is likely to stay.
The flagship electronic access system is central to the push into digital building organisation and will be kept and developed further.
